headline: Guaranteed loans in Australia's 68 million package for vineyard diversification
summary: The South Australian government announced a support plan worth 109 million dollars at the end of last week. The package includes guaranteed loans for vineyard diversification.
why: State support programmes for agriculture affect the financing and strategy of wine producers, a sector exposed to export and climate pressures.
